resources.string: Create or restore in either mode. You can switch modes in settings at any time.
Keep notes on this device, or sync encrypted changes across your devices through your server.
Notes stay on this device. Sync stops and the existing server copy is kept. Switching back uses the same workspace.
Automatically send saved changes and merge updates from your other devices. Offline edits sync when the connection returns; conflicting versions are kept for review.
Enter your recovery key, then select the existing workspace folder to restore its notes.
Create a separate workspace and save its recovery key before connecting. Notes are encrypted locally and automatically uploaded to your server.
Connect and switch to server mode
Automatic sync is on. Updates from other devices are checked regularly.
Local changes are saved and waiting to sync.
Syncing changes across devices. You can keep editing locally.
Your local notes are safe. Retry or switch to local mode in Settings → Workspace mode.
This workspace is not registered on the server yet. Enter the registration code provided by your server administrator.
